Alex S.: Hey @MJ @Natalie — FinRegCo legal asked for a hard guarantee: all inference and logs must remain in Germany (Frankfurt). They want: 1) definitive sub‑processor list for the Frankfurt deployment, 2) proof of TLS/PCA certs for any subcontractors, 3) example routing policy we can present, and 4) pricing delta if we pin them to DE only. Can someone confirm what we can ship for a hosted POC vs Dedicated/Private?

MJ R.: short answer: we can host and pin to eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Hosted defaults to geo routing but not strict pinning — we have a tenant‑pin feature (Dedicated + Private or hosted with an enterprise pin) that forces region. For hosted without pin, we may failover to another EU region on capacity issues.

Natalie C.: Subprocessors: AWS eu-central-1 is primary; our infra providers (AWS) and our logging vendor (LogKeep Inc.) are on the subprocessors list. I can export the cert bundle + PCA chain we provide to customers. Docs: https://redwood.example/docs/subprocessors-and-certificates (internal).

Ravi P.: infra note: network path can still touch control plane in our control region unless Private (VPC) deployed. For strict data residency you should push Dedicated or Private. For Hosted+pin we do data plane in Frankfurt but control plane metadata (tenant config/usage metrics) may hit our primary control region — we can flag which fields are redacted.

Alex S.: @Natalie — FinRegCo will require a cert chain and subprocessors table in the SOW. Can you drop a sanitized export? Also need a sample routing policy snippet to show the legal team.

Natalie C.: will do. exporting sanitized list now, will attach to the SOW draft.

MJ R.: sample routing policy (feel free to paste into the SOW):
```json
{
  "routing": "strict",
  "preferred_region": "eu-central-1",
  "failover": "none",
  "allowed_subprocessors": ["aws:eu-central-1"],
  "audit_logging": "local-only"
}
```

Ravi P.: FYI — if they ask about cross‑region DR we can offer a manual DR-plan: replicate encrypted snapshots to eu-west-1 but keep live inference in eu-central-1 until failover is invoked. That increases costs ~+25–35% depending on retention.

Alex S.: pricing ask: can someone give a quick hosted pin vs dedicated delta for baseline POC (100k tokens/day)? I need a ballpark for the quote.

Natalie C.: hosted + enterprise pin: base usage + a regional isolation premium (~$1,200/month) + cert export fee ($500 one-time). Dedicated (small reserved pool): +monthly reserved capacity starting ~$8k/mo (depends on GPU type) + onboarding. I'll put numbers into a spreadsheet and drop in this thread.

MJ R.: security Qs — add note: keys at rest are customer KMS for Private, hosted uses our KMS with customer-managed keys (CMKs) option for enterprise. Mentioned in the SOC package.

Alex S.: perfect. Next steps: @Natalie attach the sanitized subprocessors + cert bundle; @MJ add the routing snippet to the SOW and flag control-plane metadata caveat; @Ravi add the DR cost delta. I'll schedule a 30m call with FinRegCo for Tue. Ticket #TKT-2345.

deploy-bot: scheduled meeting invite created for Tue 10:00 CET — meeting id 123-456-789. :calendar:

Natalie C.: uploaded sanitized_subprocessors_finregco.zip to secure drive and linked in SOW draft. Will follow up in thread with numbers (ETA 2h). :white_check_mark:

MJ R.: added the routing snippet + control‑plane note into SOW draft and pinged legal for the PCA acceptance language.

Ravi P.: added DR cost estimate to sheet and shared with Alex.

Alex S.: thanks all — I'll prep the customer call notes and send an agenda.
